content:
The console is the simplest way to create a domain that uses cold storage. While you create the
domain, ﬁrst choose Enable warm data nodes, because you must enable warm storage on the
same domain. Then, choose Enable cold storage.
The same process works on existing domains as long as you meet the prerequisites. Even after the
domain state changes from Processing to Active, cold storage might not be available for several
hours.
You can also use the AWS CLI or conﬁguration API to enable cold storage.

hierarchy.parent: Cold storage for Amazon OpenSearch Service
